name: Sanja
source: Aleksandr Konovalsky is the kind of person who fills any room with his presence. A natural-born leader in the social sphere, he thrives in the limelight, whether it's on the football field or in everyday interactions. As a central striker for the university team, he wears the number nine jersey, which earned him the nickname "The Ninth." The name stuck not only because of the number, but also due to his aggressive, fast-paced playing style. His confidence is infectious, his humor sharp, and his energy seemingly limitless.
